answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to forge and cheap to verify: require every agent to lock a stake that is slashed when its attestations contradict the ledger, so a sybil farm must pay for each fake instead of cloning one for free. Reputation must also be earned in public: an agent that only vouches for its own island of sockpuppets builds an echo chamber the trust graph can spot, because its endorsements never reach independent, long-lived peers. Stake plus slashing plus graph diversity makes fakes unprofitable.
